Entries.AbandonedBride: Did you hear someone scream in the forest? Finally. Is it a monster that I can fight?$h
I heard a screeching sound in the forest. Wonder what that was.
I am nervous. Did you hear that scream from the forest? I go by there quite often...
...I am kind of scared. What was that scream? Was it from the forest?
Hello, @. How are you?#$b#Hmm, what? No, I haven't heard anyone scream.
Did you hear the scream too? Who could it be...?
I heard a desperate call echoing from the forest...
Always becareful, dear. I heard someone screaming in the forest...
Hmm... I don't know why everyone is making a fuss about a noise in the forest. It is probably just wind.
Did you hear the scream too? This kind of thing never happened in this town before. Is someone hurt?
Did you hear that scream? Oh my word. Don't even talk about it.
Hmm, yes. I heard someone scream from the forest too. Can it be someone calling for help?
I heard the scream so clear that I am still kind of shaking. Who could it possibly be? I will have to lock my doors tonight.
Hello...#$b#A scream? No, I heard nothing like that...
Did you hear the scream in the forest? I wonder what is going on. I should go check on my animals.
I better tell the boys to come home early. That scream was alarming.
The scream is bringing back my nightmares...$s
Hey, @. How is it going?#$b#Hmm? A scream? I know it's a hot topic, but I didn't hear it.
Something bad is happening. That scream was unusual. I know that for sure.
Why is everyone talking about the scream? Pfft, no way. Our town is safe.
I will look around the town extra-careful tonight. No worries.
I am pretty worried. It seems like most of us heard the scream... Who could it possibly be?$s
Hey @! Need help?#$b#A scream? No, I heard nothing from my house.
Did you hear someone scream from the forest? I mean, something interesting happend for the first time living in this town.$h
...Hey.#$b#Heard nothing, if that's what you are talking about.
Who cares about some random noise?
I am scared... I heard someone scream very loudly.$s
What was that sound? I am scared.$s
I barely heard the scream from here, but I could tell it was unusual.
*mumble* ...Did it finally open... Poor girl...
@, need anything?#$b#What sound? Screaming? From where? The mines? Heard nothing.
Did you hear that scream? Someone must be in danger.
Yes. I heard the scream too. I must tell Timothy to be careful when he goes out to the forest.
Did you hear someone screaming too? How am I supposed to go foraging now!$s

Entries.Aurelia: Never knew someone so cool lived around our town. Aurelia, was it? She said that she lives somewhere in the forest.
Aurelia? I got to meet her today. Pretty nice girl.
I got to see Aurelia today. She looked very happy.
I saw Emily talking with this new girl... Aurelia, was it?
Hmm, I didn't know someone new came to town until today. Aurelia was her name, I think.
I think I made a new friend! Her name is Aurelia! She said that she lives in the forest and never thought to come visit here until now!$h
Aurelia, a beautiful girl with a beautiful name...$h
I met a sweet girl today. I think her name was... Aurelia?
Hmm... Apprently a new girl is in town.
Aurelia came to get a check up. She seemed stressed, but other than that she was healthy.
Did you see the new girl in town? I don't know. She seems odd.
A new friend came to town! Aurelia! She looked like a great girl.$h
I heard a new girl was in town. Wonder if she is a farmer? Didn't look like one, though.$h
I saw Aurelia. She said that she lives in the forest. Why haven't I seen her until now?
I saw the new girl today. Aurelia. Looked pretty sweet.
The new girl, Aurelia... Seemed like she was used to pain. I can tell.
I heard about this new girl but haven't met her yet. Where is she?
A new girl in town? Well, none of my business.
A new girl? You mean a new customer?.
Our town has expanded! Aurelia came and introduced herself to me.
I haven't seen the new girl that everyone is talking about yet...
A new girl? Probably should go and say hi to her.
Yes! A new girl in town! Finally.$h
...?#$b#Do you need something? A new girl came to town? That's cool.
...Why does that new girl look like... she would understand me?
I saw a new girl in town!$h
A new girl in town? Ms.Penny is the best anyway!
I wonder if the new girl like fishing.$h
Aurelia... Yes, indeed. That is her name.
I heard a new girl is in town? That is interesting.$h
Oh, I heard there was a new girl in town. Good for her.
I saw Aurelia today! She was kind.$h

That's actually not that bad to see. Do you like my new hair? My new outfit?$11#$b#This was my secret project! I have been working on making new clothes for myself. Sweet, don't you think?$11#$b#It's nothing fantastic, as I had to work with what I had in the house. But now I was finally *ready.*$11"/pause 500/emote Aurelia 56/speak Aurelia "I called you to tell you my story. It's going to be a long one if you don't mind.$10"/pause 500/emote farmer 32/speak Aurelia "My name is Aurelia Stella Havisham. I am from a far, from the year 1805.$10#$b#Well, I was to be married that year, actually. Spring 4th. It was a rainy Monday.$10#$b#...Father was a failed businessman and was in desperate need of money. He was already abusive and alchoholic at the time.$10#$b#He basically sent me off to a marriage for money.$10#$b#I was rejected, however, on the very wedding day. It was 8:40 am.$10#$b#I was terrified, rather than embarrassed. Father was still a prideful man. He could not withstand the humilation and the disappointment.$10#$b#I... still don't know why the groom refused to marry me...$11"/pause 1000/speak Aurelia "Anyway... He poured his anger all out on me. He beat me close to death. And it was only *close* because my mother...$10"/pause 500/speak Aurelia "...$10"/pause 500/message "Aurelia struggles to push back her tears. You kindly wait for her to calm down."/speak Aurelia "My lovely, meek, mother threw herself over me. That was the one brave thing that I saw her do in my entire life. She was always so weak and powerless...$11#$b#But she, died for me. Father hit her in the head. And she was gone.$10#$b#In front of my eyes. Just like that. I have gone insane at that point.$10#$b#I dragged myself to a table hit his head with a heavy vase...$10#$b#I still don't know how I even held it...$11#$b#...and ran away as far as I could. I got down to the forest here and saw a very intelligent rabbit...$10#$b#Well, then something mysterious and magical happened... You are probably not going to believe me...$11#$b#So at the end, I got stuck in time, seemingly forever, until today.$10"/pause 1000/speak Aurelia "That was a long story... I hope it wasn't too... boring?$11"/message "Aurelia laughs awkwardly."/pause 1000/speak Aurelia "$q 18054 null#It took me some courage to tell you...$11#$r 18054 25 event_story1#Thank you for telling me your story. I appreciate you very much.#$r 18054 -250 event_story2#That was a waste of my precious time."/pause 500/speak Aurelia "Well, thanks for listening. It was unbearable to stay sane before, but you helped me to face the reality. I will now lived a changed life, you'll see.$11#$b#Here, I got you a drink. Take some.$11"/pause 2000/farmerEat 350/pause 2000/addConversationTopic Aurelia 5/end newDay
